industry_impact.title: 'Canadians are with you. We will always be with you': PM addresses vigil for Tumbler Ridge shooting victims
industry_impact.snippet: Prime Minister Mark Carney led federal, provincial and local leaders in offering support and praising the resilience and grace of Tumbler Ridge residents at a vigil in memory of the victims of Tuesday's mass shooting in the B.C. community.

industry_impact.title: Former minister Freeland violated election rules during 2024 byelection, watchdog finds
industry_impact.snippet: Former deputy prime minister and cabinet minister Chrystia Freeland violated election rules during a 2024 byelection, the Commissioner of Canada Elections said on Friday.

industry_impact.title: Canada’s economy heavily reliant on U.S., experts warn dependence comes with risks
